label: D2 reaching S1 via a1 right after an unrewarded rare a1->S2 trial (early episode)
explanation: Fires only on D1 and D2 steps (never GO), only when the reward input was 0 at this trial D1 (prev_reward == 0), and almost only in a1 context: action == 1 on 100% of active steps, prev_action == 1 (or unknown at the window start) on ~100%, prev_common == 0 on ~80% (rest is window start, prev unknown). So the setting is: last trial was a1 -> S2 (rare) and unrewarded, the agent stays with a1 (model-based-correct stay after rare-unrewarded). 77% of mass is at D2 when it then reaches S1 (common), where activation is largest; ~23% at the preceding D1 (weaker, and D1 is unreliable: many D1 steps matching the context do not fire, so D1 is left out of the predicate). Never fires with in_rew 1, at a2/S2 inputs, or late in episodes (ep_trial >= 60 is near-silent; strongest in trials 10-40), and is mostly in good = S1 contexts. Magnitude tracks the value head: 74% of mass at value > 8.1; adding value > 8.1 raises dev F1 to 0.57 but I recorded the plain task-variable predicate (dev P 0.45, R 0.64, F1 0.53, mass recall 0.77). All variables are observed at D2; no future variables used.
